# Davide Modolo

> AI & Machine Learning Engineer with a Master's degree in Artificial Intelligence Systems. Specializes in Deep Learning, NLP, Transformers, LLMs, RAG, and MLOps (Docker, CI/CD, model deployment & monitoring). Currently building production NLP pipelines and agentic AI systems. Open to new opportunities.

## Experience

- **AI & Machine Learning Engineer, R&D - OpenCity Labs** (Aug 2025 - Present, Remote): NLP pipelines for RAG ingestion with PII anonymization via a fine-tuned Transformer NER model (50k+ daily inputs); cross-lingual guardrails with spaCy + LLM fallback; open-source agentic AI with hybrid RAG (vector + full-text reciprocal rank fusion) and MCP tool-calling with human-in-the-loop; Dockerized services with GitLab CI.
- **Intern / AI Engineer - Eurecat Technology Center** (Apr 2024 - Jun 2024, Barcelona): Token-level uncertainty estimation for planning tasks (GPT-4o, Llama 3.1 via llama.cpp); RAG with gte-large embeddings to reduce hallucination; multimodal agent with LLaVA.
